person_updates.identity_evidence: The NARA row with no printed rank or service identifier is visually verified. An exact-name John G. Ackelmire appears in a third-party transcription of 103d Infantry Division headquarters morning reports as an Army officer and division public-relations officer in 1944-1945; postwar institutional notices place a same-named Wabash alumnus in Indianapolis journalism. Because the index supplies no corroborating rank or identifier and no accessible source links that candidate to OSS, the candidate remains unassigned pending file review.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 2 for John G. Ackelmire's identity, personnel status, civilian occupation, and OSS appointment or assignment chronology. Compare the file cautiously with the 103d Infantry Division officer and Indianapolis journalist candidate; neither postwar journalism nor a wartime Army assignment may be treated as pre-OSS without dated linkage. No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed.

research_attempts.query_text: "John G Ackelmire" OSS; "John G. Ackelmire" Office of Strategic Services; occupation employer obituary; NARA index; CIA Reading Room; Army; 103d Infantry Division; Wabash; newspaper; Library of Congress; institutional and archival searches
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: A third-party morning-report transcription documents an exact-name Army officer in 1944-1945, and postwar institutional notices document a same-named Indianapolis journalist. The NARA index prints neither rank nor service identifier for this row, and no accessible source connects the candidate to OSS or establishes pre-OSS chronology.
research_attempts.research_notes: The NARA row was visually checked. Official/NARA context, CIA Reading Room, exact-name OSS, Army, employment/occupation, obituary, alumni, newspaper, Library of Congress, and archival searches were completed. The 103d Infantry Division record identifies public-relations duties, not a division-historian assignment. Postwar journalism was not projected backward.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 2 for identity, personnel status, and the sequence between any Army assignment and OSS service.
